author: Luzerne Times
title: Senate Judiciary Committee set for voting meeting on June 26
text:
Elisabeth J. Baker, Pennsylvania State Senator from 20th District | Facebook
Elisabeth J. Baker, Pennsylvania State Senator from 20th District | Facebook
The Senate Judiciary Committee, led by Senator Lisa Baker, will convene for a voting meeting on Thursday, June 26. The session is scheduled to begin at 9:30 a.m. and will take place in Room 8E-B of the East Wing at the Capitol Complex in Harrisburg.
The committee plans to review several bills during this meeting. For those unable to attend in person, a livestream will be accessible via pasenategop.com/watch/.
Cara Laudenslager is the contact person for further information regarding the event.
